name: christmas_tree
source: Christmas/solidcraft/christmas_tree.sc (SolidCraft 0.45; Jan's Christmas_tree_v2.sc plus the tops as configuration rows, built by web/node/tree_sc_v3.mjs). Equations and the paint rule: tree_spec.md

shape._comment: shape ratios of the .sc (kw base radius / H, kt top tier tip / base radius, kp tier pitch / H, ks tier step at a flat underside / H, kr tip rounding / H); the tree has 3 tiers

star._comment: top Star (parameters of the .sc in brackets): diameter max(min_diameter, star_share % of H) (Ds), inner/outer radius q (kq), fit per side tab/slot (fg), smallest wall around the slot (wl), clearance of the lower points to the fins (cs), star at least t_min thick (st), tab width tab_w * q * Rs (wt), slot depth (q + slot_extra) * Rs (sd); the tab is fin 0 continued (t thick), from its top width out at 45 deg (tb, tf)
